then.text: Best cheese and tomato oatcake I've had all week. And I've had a few.
Cheese and tomato, from the hatch? Champion. Put it on the bar, duck, I'll have it with a pint of mild.
Wedgwood and Brindley sat in this pub in 1765, so they say, and planned the canal. I like to think they had oatcakes too. History doesn't record it.

else.text: {greeting} What'll it be? We've mild, bitter, and a fire that's been lit since about 1765.

leopard_quiz.text: Quiz night at the Leopard! Five questions. Pottery, football and anything else I can think of. Fancy it, duck?

else.text: Your loss, duck. The crisps are good tonight.

leopard_regular.text: They say this place is haunted. Doors opening by themselves, footsteps on the stairs, a chill on the landing.
I've been coming here forty years and never seen a ghost. Mind you, I've never been upstairs. I'm not daft.
